availly.name: Availly
availly.tagline: Availability you share, privacy you keep.
availly.description: Availly is a lightweight tool for managing personal and business availability, offering a sleek calendar UI and powerful sharing features.
availly.longDescription: Managing time across clients, projects, or personal commitments is often chaotic. Existing solutions are either bloated or lack customization for small teams and freelancers. Availly was designed as a lean scheduling platform: lightweight, beautiful, and shareable.
availly.challenge: Powerful yet lightweight balance, responsive mobile-first UI across calendar providers while maintaining privacy and performance.
availly.solution: Modern fast SPA, minimalist design, privacy-first approach with encrypted tokens and read-only calendar scopes.

shiftend.name: ShiftEnd
shiftend.tagline: From paper chaos to a streamlined digital workflow.
shiftend.description: ShiftEnd is a SaaS tool that simplifies compliance for Belgian restaurants by replacing the traditional dagontvangstenboek with a sleek, affordable, and legally compliant platform.
shiftend.longDescription: Small restaurants in Belgium without GKS cash register systems are required by law to maintain a daily sales log, often done on paper. This process is tedious, error prone, and outdated. ShiftEnd was built to digitize this workflow while keeping compliance at its core.
shiftend.challenge: Full compliance with Belgian regulations while designing minimal UI for non-technical users.
shiftend.solution: Clean guided interface with compliance logic, multilingual support, automated compliance checks, digital signatures, and audit trails.

delicebrugge.name: Délice Brugge
delicebrugge.tagline: From zero to a complete digital experience for a Bruges restaurant.
delicebrugge.description: For Délice Brugge we built the entire website from the ground up, from color palette and web design to a custom multilingual website with an integrated group booking system and pre-ordering menu.
delicebrugge.longDescription: Délice Brugge needed a full digital presence: a website that reflects the atmosphere of the restaurant and guides visitors smoothly through the booking process. We took this on from A to Z: color palette, web design, development and the build of a custom group booking flow where guests can compose their menu in advance, in 4 languages.
delicebrugge.challenge: Building a complete website that is both visually compelling and functional for group bookings of 6+ guests, with per-person pre-ordering in NL, EN, FR and DE.
delicebrugge.solution: Fully custom Next.js website, from color palette and web design to development. Includes an integrated group booking system, per-guest pre-ordering menu flow and full multilingual support across 4 languages.
results: Pre-order menu selection eliminates table waste

calvarychurch.name: De Pelgrim, Calvary Chapel
calvarychurch.tagline: Complete website build with bilingual CMS for independent management.
calvarychurch.description: For De Pelgrim Calvary Chapel we built the entire website from the ground up, from color palette and web design to a Next.js website with Sanity CMS, fully bilingual (NL/EN) so the team can manage everything independently.
calvarychurch.longDescription: De Pelgrim needed a fresh, modern website that reflects the community and is easy to manage by a non-technical team. We took on the full journey: the design of the color palette and visual identity of the website, the UI/UX, and the complete technical build on Next.js with Sanity CMS as the content layer, bilingual, structured and intuitive.
calvarychurch.challenge: Building a complete website for a church community, with a custom visual identity, and a bilingual CMS that can be managed independently by a non-technical team, including events, Bible verses and ministry pages.
calvarychurch.solution: Fully custom Next.js website, from color palette and web design to CMS architecture. Sanity CMS with structured bilingual content types (NL/EN), live preview and a simple editing interface for the church team.
results: Events & Bible verses editable in real-time
Fast launch thanks to structured CMS architecture

project-alpha.name: Project Alpha
project-alpha.tagline: Mobile application for finance management for Belgian banks.
project-alpha.description: An AI/ML powered finance app for Belgians.

blurry-vintage.name: Blurry Vintage
blurry-vintage.tagline: Luxury thrift fashion with a personal story.
blurry-vintage.description: Apart from the fact that Blurry is known for selling Luxury thrift clothes, it also stands for a store with personal story behind. Life can get blurry, in so many ways but we say: don't worry. We got you, your dreams & your style.
blurry-vintage.challenge: Translating the essence of Blurry Vintage into visuals was a challenge we embraced with excitement. Balancing the luxury of thrift fashion while embodying the personal narrative required a delicate touch.
blurry-vintage.solution: Our research into Blurry Vintage commenced by delving deep into the world of luxury thrift fashion, uncovering the delicate equilibrium between opulence and approachability.

claymates.name: ClayMates Ceramic Atelier
claymates.tagline: Connecting through the craft of ceramics.
claymates.description: ClayMates is more than a ceramics studio, it is a community, a place to relax, disconnect from the stressful outside world and reconnect with yourself and the clay. Whether you are a beginner or advanced, ClayMates is open to everyone.
claymates.challenge: Capturing the tactile beauty and serene ambiance of their studio within a two-dimensional medium required an approach that balanced authenticity with visual allure.
claymates.solution: Through meticulous product photography, we captured the intricate details and textures of their ceramics, allowing potential clients to appreciate the craftsmanship from afar.

ic.name: IC GlowUp Skyhome
ic.description: Innovative Commerce, Product design, brand identity
ic.challenge: The challenge lay in giving life to ideas, creating distinct identities for both the main brand and its sub-brands without the physical presence of products.
ic.solution: Our approach combined in-depth research, immersive brainstorming, and meticulous design execution to birth brands that stand as pillars of Innovative Commerce's mission.

rebelieve.name: Rebelieve by Nathan Nuyts
rebelieve.description: Rebelieve isn't just a clothing brand, it's a rallying cry for self-belief and empowerment.
rebelieve.challenge: The challenge lay in translating Nathan's personal journey and ethos into compelling visuals, fusing authenticity and aspiration seamlessly.
rebelieve.solution: We crafted a digital space that welcomed individuals on their unique journeys through immersive online ads and striking visuals.

yokoso.name: Yokoso
yokoso.description: With a commitment to customization and choice, Yokoso Sushi elevates your dining experience, allowing you to craft sushi masterpieces that reflect your taste.
yokoso.challenge: The challenge lay in visually conveying the sheer variety and customization they offer, bridging the gap between taste and imagery.
yokoso.solution: Through carefully crafted online advertising, we served up delectable visuals that invited customers to explore the world of personalized sushi.

supportportal.name: Support Portal
supportportal.tagline: Streamlined client support, powered by transparency.
supportportal.description: A dedicated support portal for Baghlabs clients to submit tickets, track progress, and stay in the loop , all in one place.
supportportal.longDescription: Managing client requests across email threads and chat messages leads to lost context and delayed responses. We built the Baghlabs Support Portal to centralize communication: clients log in, create support tickets, and follow real-time progress , while our team syncs everything directly with GitHub Issues behind the scenes.
supportportal.challenge: Building a frictionless support experience that bridges the gap between client-facing simplicity and developer-facing workflow, without duplicating effort across platforms.
supportportal.solution: A clean Next.js portal with Supabase authentication and database, integrated with the GitHub API and webhooks so every client ticket automatically becomes a trackable issue in our development workflow , with real-time status updates pushed back via GitHub webhooks.

poland-invest.name: Poland Invest ZEN
poland-invest.description: With a focus on promising locations and high potential returns, Poland Invest brings a fresh perspective to real estate investment.
poland-invest.challenge: The challenge lay in encapsulating the blend of ambition and calculated risk-taking that defines their investors.
poland-invest.solution: Our online approach aimed to mirror the confidence and foresight that define their investment strategies through precision-targeted online ads.
